model.title: AI Tax Integrity Act of 2026
model.meta: Ways and Means Committee · Rep. Vern Buchanan (R-FL)

summary.text: The bill would require the IRS to launch a pilot program using artificial intelligence to detect fraudulent tax returns and identify improper refunds or reduced tax liability. After the program concludes, it would direct the Government Accountability Office to report to Congress on how much fraud was detected, how much money was recovered, and how accurate the AI tools were at spotting tax fraud.
